name: Plugin Card
description: Draggable, resizable card container that hosts any plugin type on the canvas. Renders a header with title, minimize/fit-viewport/close buttons, and a body div for plugin content. Supports mouse-drag repositioning with 28px grid snapping, edge-based resize (E/S/SE corners), and header double-click to fit viewport. Each card generates a unique UUID via crypto.randomUUID(). Card state (position, size) is managed through callbacks.

properties.name: opts
properties.description: Configuration options including callbacks for drag/resize/focus/minimize/terminate

properties.name: onDestroy
properties.description: Callback invoked when card element is removed

methods.name: constructor
methods.signature: (parent: HTMLElement, opts: CardOptions, getTransform: () => { scale: number; panX: number; panY: number })
methods.description: Builds card DOM with header, body, edges; wires drag/resize event handlers

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Updates header title text if changed

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Replaces card body with HTML content

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Detaches event listeners, calls onDestroy, and removes DOM element

lifecycle.destroyed_by: CanvasArea.terminateCard() or user clicking X button
